streaming_input.text: The condition stays true because count starts at zero and nothing inside the loop changes it
. Each pass therefore prints the same value, and Python tests whether zero is less
than five again, so the loop continues indefinitely.
Use count equals zero; then, while true, print count, increment count by
one, and break if count is at least five. Checking after the increment prints
exactly zero through four, then exits.
